steps.eval: (() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('div,span,button')].find(b => b.offsetParent !== null && b.textContent.includes('Delete')); if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'scrolled *Delete'; } return 'MISS *Delete'; })()
